title: Explore renewable-rich voltage control
intro: Inspect a conceptual distribution network with solar, wind, local demand and an inverter control interface.

solar.label: Solar generation
solar.detail: Changes in solar output can alter power flows in a distribution network. The array represents a variable renewable source.

wind.label: Wind generation
wind.detail: The turbine illustrates another variable renewable source. Its size and placement are schematic.

grid.label: Distribution feeder
grid.detail: Poles, lines and homes represent a distribution feeder with local demand. No measured voltage profile or experimental feeder geometry is asserted.

inverter.label: Inverters & SVC
inverter.detail: The cabinets represent PV inverter and static VAR compensator (SVC) interfaces. The related study uses PPO to coordinate reactive-power control. This conceptual preview is an explainer, not a numerical power-flow solver.
